title: Parallel map
hints: Goroutines can't return values, so give each one a place to put its result: a slice made **before** the loop, with one element per input.

`out := make([]U, len(in))`. Loop `for i, v := range in` and start a goroutine that does `out[i] = f(v)`. Different goroutines write different elements, which is safe. `wg.Wait()` before returning `out`.
`out := make([]U, len(in)); var wg sync.WaitGroup; for i, v := range in { wg.Go(func() { out[i] = f(v) }) }; wg.Wait(); return out`.
